Find the global extrema of the function f(x,y)=x2y on the closed region D={(x,y):x≥0,y≥0,x2+y2≤9}, shown above.

a
fmin=2 and fmax=63
b
fmin=0 and fmax=63
c
fmin=0 and fmax=1
d
fmin=2 and fmax=0
e
fmin=1 and fmax=63
